This section hosts the traceability matrix computed from the workspace, which links nodes to the epics and stories that implemented them and lists the nodes without a work item. The workspace contains no test strategy, test scenario catalog or coverage data: testing is not described anywhere in the sources used for this plan, and this is reported as a documentation gap in section 8. Acceptance scenarios can be derived from the use cases in section 4 once a test strategy exists.
